title: Refresh release evidence linkage and freshness inputs
description: Update the release summary evidence model and/or evidence artifacts so freshness and linkage signals reflect current repository reality, then regenerate the release summary from those current inputs.

criteria: The regenerated release summary no longer references the missing tests/integration/test_e2e_workflow.py path as the current smoke authority
Freshness signals are backed by at least one current evidence artifact or by an intentionally updated current-source rule
Linkage signals are backed by current valid artifacts or intentionally migrated away from obsolete snapshot assumptions with explicit reasoning
convergence.verification: Run python scripts/release_check_summary.py and inspect the resulting summary details for freshness, linkage, and smoke-path alignment.
convergence.definition_of_done: Release evidence and summary surfaces are refreshed against current authority without fabricating obsolete historical state.

implementation.title: Audit the current warning sources
implementation.description: Map the current WARN and FAIL details in release-check-summary.md back to their actual artifact or signal source.

implementation.title: Refresh evidence or migrate the lookup rule
implementation.description: Prefer current authoritative evidence sources over recreating obsolete snapshot layouts.

implementation.title: Regenerate the release summary
implementation.description: Re-run the summary only after the evidence inputs and linkage rules match the current repository model.
